name: Order-flow imbalance forecast
hypothesis: Trade a trained short-horizon forecast from OFI with a conservative execution model.
spec: Setup: Measure event-by-event changes in best bid/ask prices and sizes, including cancellations. Entry: Trade a trained short-horizon forecast from OFI with a conservative execution model. Exit: Exit when forecast decays, imbalance reverses or risk limits trigger. Parameters to pre-register: OFI_definition, aggregation_window, model, horizon.
blocked_reason: needs a sequenced L2/L3 order-book feed; the free venues give periodic snapshots only
